answer: A newcomer could join a watch circle of seven unrelated members, reshuffled monthly, where standing grows slowly like a lotus opening one petal at a time. Each week the circle selects one past job and asks how it was done; a vague or copied answer suspends the account until a harder job passes. Running 100 fakes would mean distinct records for each and 100 spot-checks, about an hour each week, while one failure freezes that identity. At its nadir, a new account has no standing, and it earns trust only in the shade of a willow: real watching, over time.
